how: The Mismatch scorecard (elo/scorecard/scorecard.py; README.md beside it holds the bar). Research only: no page reads this file and nothing on the site uses it. Written only by scorecard.py run in the Elo job after its commit, and committed only once scorecard.py check has held it to the last commit's. calls['<game id>|<player id>'] = {season, week, gid, pid, name, pos, club, kickoff, stat, shift, tag, proj, no_elo, sd, published, written_at, grade}: every lead block (elo/data/matchups.json avg[pid].mm) of a regular-season game, rewritten while its game is to come, frozen at kickoff; grade null until graded once against DraftKings' closing main line (result over, under or push, close, open, vs_open, actual, how, at) or voided (result void, why: moved, no close, no stats, did not play, not told, off schedule). summary[season]: the running counts, rates, D and S with their 90% intervals, and the verdict once decided by the bar. A hand edit rewrites the record.
bar: Registered before the first call, never changed. The scorecard measures whether the Props tab's Mismatches tell anything about DraftKings' closing line. A row is every lead block (avg[pid].mm) the Elo job's last publish before a game's kickoff carried for that game, frozen at kickoff, graded over or under DraftKings' closing main line on its stat from props/data/espn_lines_<season>.json against the player's stat from nflverse; a push, a row with no close, a row whose game moved more than 24 hours and a player who did not play are left out. D is the over-rate of the tagged rows (mm.tag true) less the over-rate of the untagged rows (mm.tag false), pooled over the season. S is Spearman's rank correlation between mm.shift and the actual less the close, over every graded row. Each has a 90% interval from 10,000 bootstrap resamples of games (seed 2026). The scorecard is decided once, when every regular-season game it froze rows for has been graded or voided (at the latest 14 days after the season's last regular-season kickoff): fewer than 30 graded tagged rows is UNDECIDED; otherwise PASS only if D's interval and S's interval both lie wholly above 0; FAIL if D's interval lies wholly below 0; anything else is NO EDGE SHOWN. Before the decision the ledger carries the running counts, rates, D and S with their intervals, never a verdict. A PASS only makes the Mismatches a candidate for a change of their own, tested again; nothing on the site reads this scorecard, and nothing is fitted, tuned or chosen on it.
